==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
* Attacks starting from Upgrade 8 are able to hit air type enemies. 
* After Update 14.0.0, Tango (Flash God) has been given the {{Damage Type|Rose|Rose}} Damage type, along with other units without a second damage type.
* Tango (Flash God) has also been given 50% crit chance which can be useful.
* After the rerelease of the game, Tango (Flash God) has recived a damage buff with a few other units like [[Hubris (The One)]],  [[JIO (Over Heaven)]], [[Umbra (Nuclear)]].
